attempted_claim: Let (R,m,k) be a complete regular local ring of mixed characteristic (0,p) with F-finite residue field, and let Q subset R be a radical ideal of big height h >= 2 such that R/Q is perfectoid pure. Does the finite exact containment Q^{(hn-h+1)} subseteq Q^n hold for every integer n >= 1, where Q^{(m)} is the m-th symbolic power and h = max{ht P : P in Min(R/Q)}?
decisive_failure: No proof or disproof of the perfectoid-pure Harbourne containment was obtained. Three distinct routes (direct Grifo-Huneke translation, asymptotic perfectoid/BCM test ideals, closure-theoretic BCM adaptation) were each blocked at the same missing ingredient: a general perfectoid-purity Fedder-type colon or purity-enhanced Skoda/subadditivity lemma for arbitrary radical ideals in mixed characteristic. Literature consulted (Grifo-Huneke, Ma-Schwede, Murayama, Yoshikawa) contains only the unconditional hn bound and hypersurface/complete-intersection purity criteria, not the needed general lemma. No original emergent increment was produced; the routine Theorem-B specialization Q^{(hn-h+1)} subset Q^{n-2}Q^{(2)} is immediate prior-work corollary with a residual symbolic factor, and star configurations show that factor cannot be removed formally.
